description: A `when:` track fires once its label was applied by a human and the `after` elapsed: the run posts the reminder, leaving the label in place.
warrant:
version: 1
languages:
  - en
lifecycle:
  tracks:
    - name: review-stale
      when: review
      resets: author
      steps:
        - after: 5d
          say: "Has this review been addressed?"
